fact: UNECA reports Chad pre-validated its draft National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (2027-2035 priorities) at an N'Djamena workshop, to be submitted to the Government by end-2026.

A pre-validation workshop in N'Djamena reviewed Chad's draft National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (2027-2035, drafted with the UN Economic Commission for Africa), which is to go to the government by the end of 2026.
The document says Chad's AI strategy has been pre-validated, with the ministry of telecommunications and digital economy leading.
